purpose: Collect genuinely prospective observations capable of separating profitable and losing occurrences of a frozen loop orientation after the compact retrospective admission, route-forecast, and sequential path models failed or abstained.

opened_development_evidence.main_seed: expected_leg_then_diversion was negative in four opened candidate-period cells and remains prospective-only

opened_development_evidence.surface_relation: different causal breakout surface used only for mechanism-transfer development
findings: The compact direct Bayesian-ridge payoff model classified every scored admission as unknown under its frozen 90-percent predictive interval.
The five-way causal route forecast did not beat its candidate prior consistently or securely.
Adding causal route probabilities did not improve direct payoff error and conservative selector return in both candidates.
Sequential route plus completed-bar MFE, MAE, retracement, ATR, and volatility state classified every scored path as unknown under the frozen interval.
Point-mean-only policies were diagnostics and cannot qualify; the sequential point policy reduced paired payoff overall and for cycle_07.
No diversion-specific payoff table was opened because genuinely sealed data did not exist.

activation_requirements: Set an immutable activation timestamp before the first observation; no 2023, 2024, or 2025 observation can enter prospective evaluation.
Use only sessions whose raw data and outcomes were genuinely unseen when this contract, feature clock, model source, costs, and evaluation code were hashed.
Create separate append-only admission, completed-bar, and outcome ledgers; outcome fields remain sealed until the predeclared window closes.
Freeze source hashes, feature availability timestamps, missingness rules, candidate and control sets, uncertainty method, support floor, and review schedule.
Do not activate through the trading application; any future logger requires separate explicit authorization and remains non-executing research infrastructure.
Independently audit leakage, timestamps, next-open counterfactuals, row immutability, and exact replay before opening outcomes.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: With genuinely prospective support, a frozen partially pooled payoff model may produce calibrated positive, negative, and unknown states with nonzero conservative coverage.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: The opened 2024 BayesianRidge results cannot be used to select features, thresholds, or a replacement model.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: A causally detected expected-leg-then-diversion state may identify an unfavorable payoff branch.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: Evaluate only after the prospective seal; no opened-period exception search.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: A route forecast may add payoff information only if it first beats its causal class-prior baseline and then improves payoff prediction out of sample.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: Never substitute realised route, child, morph, completion, or diversion labels for forecasts.

prospective_hypotheses.claim: Causal running excursion and retracement may add payoff information after a state event once enough sealed observations exist.
prospective_hypotheses.guard: No threshold or checkpoint may be selected from opened 2023, 2024, or 2025 paths.
